data.text:
VIETNAM 

🇻🇳 Typhoon Bualoi Hits Vietnam: 8 Dead, 17 Missing as Floods and Storm Damage Spread

Sep 29,2025

Typhoon Bualoi struck Vietnam on Monday, September 29, killing 8 people and leaving 17 others missing. The storm caused widespread flooding, destroyed 245 houses, and inundated nearly 1,400 hectares of rice and other crops.

The typhoon, which weakened as it moved toward Laos, led to the evacuation of over 28,500 people and disruption of hundreds of flights as four central airports were closed.

Vietnam, with its long coastline along the South China Sea, is prone to typhoons formed east of the Philippines, where at least 10 people died from Bualoi last week. Authorities continue rescue and relief operations as the country grapples with damage to infrastructure and communities.
